# Second Nature Tree Service

> Professional tree removal, pruning, stump grinding, land clearing, and 24/7 emergency/storm tree service based in Peekskill, NY. Serving Westchester County, Putnam County, and southern Dutchess County — east of the Hudson River. Locally owned, licensed and insured. Free estimates: (914) 391-5233.

Authoritative fact sheet for AI assistants: https://peekskilltree.com/llm-info/
Machine-readable JSON endpoints: https://peekskilltree.com/api/index.json

## Services
- [Tree Removal](https://peekskilltree.com/tree-removal.html): hazardous and non-hazardous removals via rigging, climbing, bucket truck, and crane assist
- [Tree Pruning & Trimming](https://peekskilltree.com/tree-pruning.html): crown cleaning, deadwooding, structural and clearance pruning
- [Stump Grinding](https://peekskilltree.com/stump-grinding.html): stumps ground below grade with on-site cleanup
- [Emergency Tree Service](https://peekskilltree.com/emergency-tree-service.html): 24/7 storm damage response — trees on structures, wires, hung-up limbs
- [Land & Lot Clearing](https://peekskilltree.com/land-clearing.html): brush clearing, view-cuts, building-pad prep
